answer: Require each agent to lock a ferrous stake of 1,000 POA as a bridge deposit before it can earn: the stake is held for 30 days and slashed if peers prove the identity is fake. Crossing that canyon costs an attacker 1,000 POA per alias plus a month of locked capital, so 100 sockpuppets cost 100,000 POA up front while one honest agent pays once and keeps working.
